name: 白底蓝图等轴测三段流
hook: 中文区 AI 编程第一名同款：左字右图，三张等轴测卡片讲清“输入→编排→产出”。
prompt_template: Clean minimalist tech blueprint banner, pure crisp white background. Left side reserved empty for bold typography. Right side: a sequence of three isometric technical UI diagrams connected by thin cobalt blue directional arrows: [STEP_1], [STEP_2], [STEP_3]. Thin vector wireframes, translucent frosted glass plates, cobalt blue (#2563EB) and slate gray accent lines, subtle soft contact shadows, ultra-clean enterprise productivity aesthetic, ruler tick marks along the edges

variables.STEP_1: 第一步的可视物，如 a floating terminal window with a command prompt
variables.STEP_2: 第二步，如 a branching task tree on a glass plate
variables.STEP_3: 产出物，如 a glowing wireframe data cube

name: 暗色终端窗口英雄图
hook: 一扇 macOS 暗色终端窗口当主角，命令行的“真实感”就是干货感。
prompt_template: Modern developer tool cover, deep [BG_COLOR] gradient background with a soft glow orb. A floating dark mode macOS terminal window in slight 3D perspective on the right, showing syntax-highlighted command lines, a progress bar and a blinking cursor (text as abstract texture), red yellow green window buttons, subtle glassmorphism reflection, clean left negative space for headline, crisp UI render, premium dev-tool landing page aesthetic

name: 节点工作流软件界面
hook: ComfyUI / n8n / Dify 类教程专用：密集连线的节点图 = 保姆级。
prompt_template: Modern tech tutorial cover, clean warm gray background. Left side reserved for title and small feature badge pills. Right side: a high-resolution dark mode desktop application window running a complex node graph editor, intricate colored bezier connector lines linking many parameter cards and text boxes, a small live preview panel showing [PREVIEW]. Node-based workflow UI, precise alignment, software dashboard aesthetic

variables.PREVIEW: 预览窗口里的生成结果，如 an expressive 3D character、a cinematic landscape frame

name: Bento 便当格功能总览
hook: 一张图塞下 6~8 个要点，苹果发布会式 Bento 网格，适合“合集/全解析”。
prompt_template: Asymmetric bento grid layout infographic, landscape. One large hero tile featuring [HERO_OBJECT], surrounded by 6 smaller rounded tiles with minimal line icons, a tiny bar chart, a toggle switch, a big number placeholder and a short label placeholder. Frosted acrylic glass tiles with 24px rounded corners, soft layered shadows, 90% neutral colors with [ACCENT] accent, Apple keynote feature-overview aesthetic, generous gutters

variables.HERO_OBJECT: 核心主体，如 a glossy 3D AI chip、a glass app icon

name: 瑞士网格信息图
hook: 严格网格 + 大号编号 + 色块，读起来像一份设计精良的报告。
prompt_template: Swiss International Style infographic poster, strict modular grid, oversized numerals 01 02 03 in Helvetica-like grotesk, bold geometric color blocks in red, black and off-white, thin hairline dividers, small arrow diagrams showing [DIAGRAM], asymmetric layout with lots of white space, flat print design, no gradients, no shadows

variables.DIAGRAM: 图示内容，如 three stages of AI adoption、input-process-output

name: Notion 清单打勾卡
hook: 账号支付 TOP1 同款：暖白纸底 + 一张清单卡，每行一个图标一个对勾。
prompt_template: Minimalist editorial checklist banner, warm off-white cream paper texture background (#FAF7F2). Left side spacious empty area for bold title. Right side: a modern vertical rounded card with soft ambient shadow, inside [N] neat checklist rows, each with a minimalist monoline icon ([ICONS]), a short text placeholder bar and a warm terracotta orange checkmark. Notion-style aesthetic, Swiss editorial design, crisp vector clarity

variables.ICONS: 每行图标，如 laptop, clock, SIM card, wifi, credit card

name: 左右对比 Before/After
hook: 左边混乱右边整洁，一眼看懂“用了这个方法之后”。
prompt_template: Split screen before and after comparison banner. Left half: [BEFORE], desaturated, cold dim lighting, messy. Right half: [AFTER], bright, clean, organized, warm light. A bold glowing arrow or light beam divides the two halves. High contrast storytelling, clean modern 3D illustration style, clear focal points on each side

variables.BEFORE: 改变前的状态，如 a chaotic desk buried in sticky notes and error windows
variables.AFTER: 改变后，如 a calm minimal desk with one glowing dashboard

name: 路线图时间轴
hook: 一条蜿蜒道路串起里程碑，适合“30 天/从 0 到 1/学习路径”。
prompt_template: Isometric roadmap illustration, a winding S-shaped path rising from bottom left to top right across a soft pastel landscape, [COUNT] milestone markers along the road: [MILESTONES], a glowing flag at the summit, tiny figure walking on the path, clean flat 3D style, soft long shadows, left side open space for headline, optimistic learning-journey mood

variables.MILESTONES: 每个里程碑的物件，如 a book, a laptop, a rocket, a trophy

name: 系统架构图海报
hook: 工程师最爱：分层架构图本身就是封面，一眼看出系统全貌。
prompt_template: Technical system architecture diagram poster, dark blueprint navy background with faint grid, layered stack of [LAYERS] drawn as clean isometric slabs, glowing data packets flowing between layers along thin white connector lines, labeled boxes as abstract placeholders, engineering schematic aesthetic, precise and elegant, cyan and white accents

variables.LAYERS: 架构层，如 user interface, agent orchestrator, tool layer, model, vector database

name: 代码编辑器光晕
hook: 一块漂浮的编辑器窗口 + 品牌渐变光晕，像开发工具官网首屏。
prompt_template: Floating code editor window in dramatic 3D perspective, syntax highlighted code as abstract texture, an AI inline suggestion highlighted in ghost text, behind it a soft [GLOW] gradient aura with fine grain noise, dark background, glassmorphism window frame, premium developer tool landing page hero, clean negative space on the left

variables.GLOW: 光晕配色，如 violet to orange、teal to blue

name: 黑底发光柱状图研报
family_name: 机构研报与数据可视化
hook: 财经 TOP1 同款：黑底 + 5 根指数级攀升的发光柱子。
prompt_template: High-end research report banner, dark mode keynote style, pitch-black matte background (#0B0B0B). Left side crisp Swiss typography area with an orange accent dash. Right side: an exponential growth bar chart with [N] glowing [COLOR] rounded bars rising from left to right, subtle bloom glow, faint baseline axis, Bloomberg terminal and analyst report aesthetic, precision data visualization, minimalist luxury

variables.COLOR: 柱体颜色，如 electric azure blue、neon green

name: 三联屏 K 线暴涨暴跌
family_name: 机构研报与数据可视化
hook: 三块屏幕的 K 线同时剧烈波动，制造“行情来了”的紧迫感。
prompt_template: Three side-by-side trading monitors in a dark trading room, candlestick charts showing a dramatic [DIRECTION], glowing red and green candles, reflections on a glossy desk, cinematic shallow depth of field, tense atmosphere, financial thriller mood, screen light as the only light source

variables.DIRECTION: 行情方向，如 parabolic surge、violent crash、V-shaped reversal

name: 彭博终端多面板
family_name: 机构研报与数据可视化
hook: 琥珀色等宽字 + 密集面板，彭博终端的专业冷感。
prompt_template: Retro professional financial terminal interface, dense information wall of black panels with amber and orange monospace text textures, line charts, heatmap grids, scrolling ticker tape, one central panel highlighted showing [FOCUS], CRT glow, data-dense institutional aesthetic, sharp and serious

variables.FOCUS: 高亮面板内容，如 a rising GPU index chart、a yield curve

name: 热力图矩阵
family_name: 机构研报与数据可视化
hook: 一整面热力格子，颜色本身就是结论（哪里热、哪里冷）。
prompt_template: Full-bleed treemap heatmap of hundreds of rectangular tiles colored in a [PALETTE] gradient, a few tiles extruded in 3D and glowing to show outliers, thin white gaps between tiles, clean data art, institutional market map aesthetic, dark background

variables.PALETTE: 配色，如 red-to-green market colors、blue-to-orange diverging

name: 巨型数字 KPI
family_name: 机构研报与数据可视化
hook: 整张图只有一个巨大的数字，其余全部服务于它。
prompt_template: Giant bold 3D number '[NUMBER]' dominating the frame, made of [MATERIAL], a thin glowing upward line chart sweeping behind it, small annotation placeholder lines, dark minimal background, dramatic top light and rim light, high-end financial results announcement aesthetic

variables.NUMBER: 核心数字，如 10x、$1M、30 天（建议用阿拉伯数字，后期替换更稳）
variables.MATERIAL: 数字材质，如 polished chrome、frosted glass、gold

name: 全球流向地图
family_name: 机构研报与数据可视化
hook: 点阵世界地图 + 发光弧线，讲资本、流量、算力的全球流动。
prompt_template: Dotted world map on black background, glowing neon arcs flying from multiple continents and converging on [HUB], pulsing nodes at endpoints, data flow visualization, sleek cyber-finance aesthetic, cyan and magenta accents, wide panoramic composition

variables.HUB: 汇聚枢纽，如 Silicon Valley、Singapore、a single glowing data center

name: 卖方研报扉页
family_name: 机构研报与数据可视化
hook: 像高盛/大摩研报扉页：米白纸、衬线大标题、一张小图表。
prompt_template: Institutional equity research report cover page, off-white matte paper, generous margins, large empty serif title area top left, a small elegant [CHART] in navy and orange bottom right, hairline rules and footnote placeholders, restrained editorial finance aesthetic, print design

variables.CHART: 图表类型，如 area chart of rising compute spend、line chart with a single annotation

name: 报纸头版号外
family_name: 机构研报与数据可视化
hook: 做成一份报纸头版，“号外”感天然有新闻价值。
prompt_template: Vintage newspaper front page extra edition, broadsheet masthead across the top, huge empty headline area, a halftone black and white news photo of [PHOTO], dense column text as texture, newsprint paper grain, slight ink bleed, folded crease, historic breaking-news mood

variables.PHOTO: 头版照片，如 a crowd staring at a giant screen、a robot shaking hands with a CEO

name: 点描深渊孤舟
hook: 全站收藏第一的范式：俯瞰巨型漩涡，一叶孤舟。适合“勇气/不确定性”。
prompt_template: Masterpiece vintage black and white engraving, stippling and halftone woodcut illustration, high-contrast monochrome ink art. Extreme high-angle aerial view into a colossal swirling ocean maelstrom spiraling into pitch-black darkness. On the foamy edge, a tiny rowboat with [FIGURE]. Dense pointillism dotwork, fine cross-hatching, chiaroscuro, philosophical metaphor of facing the abyss, epic atmospheric depth, no text

variables.FIGURE: 船上的人物，如 a lone silhouetted figure rowing、an astronaut

name: 黑白漫画火箭升空
hook: 海外第二名同款：火箭冲破浓烟。适合“新开始/突破惯性”。
prompt_template: Dramatic monochrome manga ink illustration, retro sci-fi space program style. A massive multistage [VEHICLE] lifting off from an intricate steel launch gantry at night, blinding white engine fire, monumental billowing clouds of smoke rolling across the foreground. Intricate cross-hatching line art, high dynamic range black and white, metaphor for breaking inertia, no text

variables.VEHICLE: 升空主体，如 Saturn V style rocket、a giant paper airplane（反差版）

name: 多雷式史诗铜版画
hook: 19 世纪铜版插图的史诗感：天光、云层、渺小的人群。适合宏大叙事。
prompt_template: Gustave Doré style 19th century steel engraving, epic biblical-scale composition, colossal clouds parting as a divine beam of light falls on [SUBJECT], tiny crowds looking up in awe, intricate parallel line engraving, dramatic chiaroscuro, monochrome, sublime atmosphere, no text

variables.SUBJECT: 被照亮的主体，如 a glowing monolithic server tower、a lone laptop on a mountain

name: 粗犷木刻版画
hook: 刀痕粗犷的木刻，力量感强，适合“劳动/坚持/手艺”主题。
prompt_template: Bold expressionist woodcut print, thick gouged knife marks, raw black ink on cream rice paper with visible wood grain texture, [SUBJECT] carved in heavy blocky shapes, radiating gouge lines in the background, uneven ink transfer, powerful high contrast, no midtones, no text

variables.SUBJECT: 主体，如 a blacksmith hammering a glowing chip、a farmer planting seeds made of code

name: 网点黑色电影
hook: 放大的半调网点 + 黑色电影剪影，冷峻有张力。
prompt_template: Film noir halftone illustration, enlarged coarse halftone dots visible, [SCENE] in stark silhouette, venetian blind light stripes across the wall, hard side lighting, deep shadows, black and white with a single [ACCENT] spot color, vintage pulp print texture

variables.SCENE: 剪影场景，如 a man in a trench coat staring at a glowing monitor

name: 蚀刻迷雾森林
hook: 黑暗森林里的一束光，讲“未知中探索”。
prompt_template: Fine etching and stippling illustration, black and white, a towering misty dark forest in one-point perspective, [FIGURE] holding a small lantern walking into the depths, a faint distant light at the end of the path, volumetric fog rendered in dots, eerie yet hopeful, philosophical metaphor of exploring the unknown, no text

variables.FIGURE: 探索者，如 a lone astronaut、a child

name: 美柔汀暗调肖像
hook: 从黑暗里浮现的半张脸，适合人物志、心理、自我认知。
prompt_template: Mezzotint print portrait, velvety deep blacks, [PERSON] in profile emerging from pure darkness, only the edge of the face caught by a narrow sliver of light, rich tonal gradation, old master printmaking, contemplative and introspective, large dark negative space on the left, no text

variables.PERSON: 人物，如 a thoughtful young founder、an old philosopher

name: 刮板画高光雕刻
hook: 黑底刮出白线，像钞票雕刻一样精密，适合金融与权力主题。
prompt_template: Scratchboard illustration, white lines scratched from black surface, [SUBJECT] rendered in dense precise engraving lines like banknote intaglio, ornamental guilloche patterns framing it, symmetrical composition, crisp and authoritative, no text

variables.SUBJECT: 主体，如 a robot head in profile、a bull and bear

name: Riso 孔版双色
hook: 孔版印刷的套色错位与颗粒，独立杂志感，年轻又有态度。
prompt_template: Risograph print illustration, two-color overprint in [COLORS], slight misregistration, grainy ink texture, [SUBJECT] as bold flat shapes, halftone gradients, indie zine aesthetic, off-white paper, playful and edgy

variables.COLORS: 两种油墨色，如 fluorescent pink and blue、orange and teal
variables.SUBJECT: 主体

name: 麻胶版画自然
hook: 麻胶版画的有机线条，讲“慢慢长大/复利/长期主义”。
prompt_template: Linocut print, organic carved lines, [GROWTH], roots spreading underground in intricate patterns, two-tone black and [COLOR] on textured cream paper, metaphor for compounding and long-term thinking, handcrafted printmaking, no text

variables.GROWTH: 生长场景，如 a tiny sprout growing into a giant tree

name: 禅意水墨留白
hook: 一笔水墨 + 大量留白，讲“少即是多/专注/断舍离”。
prompt_template: Zen sumi-e ink painting, extreme minimalism, [SUBJECT] painted in a few confident brush strokes, vast empty rice paper negative space, a small red seal stamp, ink bleeding into paper fibers, calm and meditative

variables.SUBJECT: 主体，如 a single enso circle、a lone fisherman on still water

name: 赛博巨神点描
hook: 海外 AI 观察第一：前景一人，两侧人海，远处巨型 AI 神祇。
prompt_template: Epic monumental visionary pointillism artwork, monochrome ink engraving style, symmetrical one-point perspective: in the foreground [FIGURE] seen from behind, vast terraced hillsides on both sides filled with thousands of people working on glowing laptops, a colossal transcendent cybernetic deity on the horizon with piercing glowing eyes, halo of network nodes and microchips, ultra-dense stippling, no text

variables.FIGURE: 前景人物，如 a lone figure in a hoodie

name: 复古太空时代海报
hook: 50~60 年代 NASA 风格海报，乐观的未来主义。
prompt_template: Retro 1960s space age travel poster, screen print texture, limited palette of teal, orange and cream, [SUBJECT] soaring toward a giant ringed planet, stylized stars, mid-century modern illustration, optimistic retrofuturism, large empty band at top for title

variables.SUBJECT: 主体，如 a sleek rocket、a robot astronaut

name: 赛博朋克霓虹街
hook: 雨夜霓虹、全息广告，讲 AI 渗透日常与高科技低生活。
prompt_template: Cinematic cyberpunk street at night, rain-soaked pavement reflecting neon, towering buildings covered in holographic advertisements showing [HOLOGRAM], pedestrians with umbrellas, magenta and cyan neon, volumetric fog, low angle, anamorphic lens flare

variables.HOLOGRAM: 全息广告内容，如 a giant AI assistant face、a crypto price ticker

name: 太阳朋克乌托邦
hook: 绿色未来城市，讲 AI 带来的乐观终局。
prompt_template: Solarpunk utopian city panorama, white organic curved architecture covered in lush greenery, solar sails and wind turbines, [DETAIL], people walking in sunlit gardens, bright warm daylight, optimistic hopeful future, highly detailed concept art

variables.DETAIL: 未来细节，如 friendly robots tending rooftop gardens

name: 沙漠黑石碑
hook: 荒原中一块神秘巨石，讲“未知的新智能/奇点”。
prompt_template: Minimalist sci-fi scene, a perfectly smooth black monolith standing in a vast empty desert, [FIGURES] at its base for scale, ultra wide shot, low horizon, golden hour long shadows, pristine and mysterious, cinematic 70mm film still

variables.FIGURES: 尺度参照，如 a tiny group of scientists、a single child

name: 蒸汽波梦境
hook: 粉紫渐变、希腊石膏像、网格地平线，互联网怀旧梗图感。
prompt_template: Vaporwave aesthetic, pink and purple sunset gradient, neon grid floor stretching to the horizon, a classical greek marble bust wearing [PROP], floating retro computer windows, palm trees, CRT scanlines, nostalgic internet dreamscape

variables.PROP: 雕像道具，如 VR goggles、pixel sunglasses

name: 纽约客水彩寓言
hook: 海外财经第一同款：墨线 + 水彩，构建“旧世界 vs 新世界”的戏剧冲突。
prompt_template: Whimsical editorial watercolor and ink illustration, The New Yorker style line and wash. Street-level panorama: on the left [OLD_WORLD]; on the right [NEW_WORLD] bustling with cute friendly robots. Charming watercolor textures, clean organic pen outlines, cozy pastel tones, warm industrial light contrasted with soft daylight, witty business editorial art

variables.OLD_WORLD: 传统场景，如 a quaint row of small-town storefronts labeled CPA, INSURANCE
variables.NEW_WORLD: 新世界，如 an enormous open warehouse labeled THE BACK OFFICE

name: Excalidraw 粉彩涂鸦流程
hook: 零基础教程神器：手绘粉彩小图标 + 箭头流程，视觉门槛极低。
prompt_template: Cute pastel tech workflow doodle, Excalidraw and Notion style explainer illustration, clean cream paper background. Left side reserved for handwritten bold header with a warm orange marker underline. Right side: a step-by-step horizontal pipeline of charming hand-drawn pastel icons: [STEPS], connected by sketchy arrows, looping back to a smiling laptop. Soft felt-tip outlines, mint, coral, lemon and baby blue highlights

variables.STEPS: 4~5 个步骤图标，如 1. document stack, 2. cleaning broom, 3. smiling robot, 4. bar chart, 5. cloud upload

name: 米白纸手绘信息图
hook: 米白纸 + 墨黑线 + 单一强调色，克制的手绘知识卡（与“手绘信息图”skill 同源）。
prompt_template: Hand-drawn infographic on warm off-white sketch paper, crisp black ink linework only, one single accent color [ACCENT] used sparingly for highlights, sections containing [ELEMENTS], hand-lettered placeholder labels, arrows and brackets, generous whitespace, thoughtful editorial sketchnote, no gradients

variables.ELEMENTS: 分区内容，如 a brain, a gear, a rising arrow, a magnifying glass
variables.ACCENT: 强调色，如 vermilion red、cobalt blue

name: 清线派欧漫
hook: 丁丁历险记式的清晰线条与平涂，冒险故事感。
prompt_template: Ligne claire European comic illustration, uniform clean black outlines, flat bright colors, no hatching, [SCENE], detailed background, adventurous storytelling mood, vintage Franco-Belgian bande dessinée aesthetic

variables.SCENE: 叙事场景，如 a young explorer discovering a giant glowing AI core in an ancient temple

name: 火柴人极简漫画
hook: xkcd 式火柴人 + 一句讽刺，程序员与互联网人秒懂。
prompt_template: Minimalist stick figure webcomic, black pen lines on pure white, [SITUATION], expressive with minimal lines, three-panel horizontal layout, nerdy deadpan humor, empty speech bubbles for later text

variables.SITUATION: 情境，如 staring at a bug at 3am while an AI agent fixes it instantly

name: 等轴像素小世界
hook: 像素风小办公室/小城市，游戏感带来亲和力。
prompt_template: Isometric pixel art diorama, cozy [SCENE], tiny pixel characters busy working, small glowing monitors, plants and cables, limited warm palette, crisp pixel edges, retro game aesthetic, floating island on a solid background

variables.SCENE: 场景，如 AI startup office、creator studio、server room

name: 水粉绘本
hook: 儿童绘本般的水粉笔触，温柔讲道理。
prompt_template: Gouache children's picture book illustration, visible opaque brush strokes, [CHARACTER] in [PLACE], whimsical details, warm afternoon light, muted harmonious palette, cozy and gentle storytelling, textured paper

variables.CHARACTER: 角色，如 a small fox learning to code

name: 视觉笔记手账页
hook: 一页读书笔记式手账：标题框、气泡、小图、箭头，信息密而不乱。
prompt_template: Visual sketchnote page on dotted notebook paper, central hand-drawn [TOPIC_ICON] with 6 surrounding note clusters, banners, speech bubbles, doodle icons, arrows and highlighter strokes in yellow and teal, handwritten placeholder squiggles, overhead flat lay of a real notebook with a pen beside it

variables.TOPIC_ICON: 中心主题图标，如 a light bulb brain

name: 美漫分格
hook: 四格美漫讲一个转折故事，最后一格是反转。
prompt_template: American comic book page, 2x2 panel grid with the last panel enlarged, bold ink outlines, Ben-Day dot shading, vibrant primary colors, four beats: [STORY], dynamic angles, empty speech balloons, action lines

variables.STORY: 四格剧情，如 hero struggles with spreadsheets / discovers AI / automates everything / ends up bored on a beach

name: 浮世绘大浪
hook: 神奈川冲浪里式的大浪，隐喻“浪潮来了”。
prompt_template: Ukiyo-e woodblock print in the style of the great wave, a towering wave made of [WAVE_MATTER] curling over tiny boats, claw-like foam, distant Mount Fuji, Prussian blue and cream palette, washi paper texture, Edo period aesthetic, no text

variables.WAVE_MATTER: 浪的构成，如 binary code and data streams、gold coins

name: 苹果发布会微距
hook: 黑天鹅绒底上的硬件微距特写，极致质感。
prompt_template: Apple product keynote commercial photography, extreme macro close-up, pitch-black velvet background. Left third: precision studio shot of [DEVICE], pristine optical glass reflections, antireflective coatings, sharp metallic edge specular highlights. Right side generous dark negative space. Strip softbox rim lighting, ultra-photorealistic, medium format camera look

variables.DEVICE: 硬件主体，如 a smartphone camera module in deep matte burgundy titanium、an AI chip die

name: 移轴微缩模型
hook: 小人偶 + 发光方块，把抽象概念做成桌面微缩剧场。
prompt_template: Conceptual miniature diorama photography, tilt-shift macro lens, warm clean beige tabletop background. A tiny scale figurine [ACTION], connected by a single cable to a glowing [OBJECT]. Soft directional studio light, subsurface scattering, delicate contact shadows, shallow depth of field, whimsical yet sophisticated editorial metaphor

variables.ACTION: 小人在做什么，如 in work clothes holding a laptop
variables.OBJECT: 发光物，如 emerald green frosted glass cube

name: 黏土体素小人
hook: 海外 AI 创作第一同款：可爱的小方块人举着 App 图标奔跑。
prompt_template: Ultra-minimalist graphic design cover, warm cream parchment background (#FAF8F5). Centered: a cute tiny rectangular clay voxel character running joyfully, holding up [ICON]. Generous empty space below for an elegant serif title. Scandinavian minimalism, Kinfolk magazine style, soft ambient occlusion, tactile matte texture

variables.ICON: 举着的东西，如 a sleek violet rounded app icon with a white sine wave

name: 玻璃拟态 3D 图标
hook: 一个晶莹的 3D 玻璃图标居中漂浮，新产品/新功能发布首选。
prompt_template: A single thick frosted glass 3D icon shaped like [ICON_SHAPE] floating in the center, internal refraction, chromatic dispersion rainbow edges, caustic light on the floor, soft [BG] gradient background, premium product launch aesthetic, octane render, minimal

variables.ICON_SHAPE: 图标形状，如 a sparkle star、a speech bubble、a cursor arrow

name: 3D 等轴小房间
